overview.title: Overview

orders.title: Orders

create.title: New order
create.merchantNoHint: Must be unique. Used to match callbacks to your system.

tx.title: Transactions

wd.title: Withdrawals

wd.cancelConfirm: Cancel this withdrawal? The frozen amount returns to your available balance.

wd.balanceNote: Your available balance is shared by all three chains; choose the chain when you withdraw.

api.title: API settings
api.secretHidden: Shown only once when generated. We cannot show it again.
api.regenConfirm: Generate a new Secret? The old one stops working immediately; update your system first.

api.ipHint: One IPv4 or IPv6 address per line. API withdrawals are only accepted from these addresses.

api.errIp: Line {n} is not a valid IP address.
api.testSent: Test callback sent. See Callbacks for the result.
api.sandboxBody: Use the separate sandbox key on the staging environment (TRON Nile testnet, test tokens only).

customers.title: Customers
customers.body: Each customer has one permanent address. Every payment to it belongs to that customer; your balance is not split by customer.

create.title: New customer
create.idHint: Cannot be changed later. Letters, digits, _ - . @ (1–128).
create.name: Name
create.created: Customer created. Receiving addresses are generated per chain when the customer makes a deposit.
create.createdChains: Customer created. Addresses already generated are shown below.

detail.exported: Prototype: the customer statement would download here.

customers.chainsBody: Each customer gets one permanent address per chain, generated when it makes a deposit on that chain. The Ethereum and BSC addresses are the same string (same contracts on both chains), but tell the payer which network to use.

errors.locked: Too many wrong attempts. Sign-in is locked for 15 minutes.
errors.bad_code: The authenticator code is wrong or already used. Wait for the next code.
errors.insufficient_balance: Insufficient balance: amount + fee exceeds your available balance.
errors.order_mode_disabled: Order mode is not enabled for your account.
errors.invalid_setup_link: This set-up link is invalid or has expired. Ask us to send a new one.
errors.weak_password: Password must be at least 12 characters.
errors.cannot_match: This deposit cannot be matched to this order.
errors.not_matched: This deposit is not matched to this order.

errors.address_not_registered: This address is not a wallet you registered on this chain.

picker.placeholder: Search by customer ID, name or email, or type a new ID
picker.none: No matching customer. Type a new ID to create one.
picker.empty: No customers yet. Type an ID to create one.
picker.existing: Existing customer: name and email filled in. Edit them on the Customers page.
picker.isNew: New customer: it will be created when you submit (its address is generated per chain at deposit time).

chain.laterNote: Assigned automatically when release 2 goes live; nothing to do.
chain.notYet: Not generated yet: created when the customer makes a deposit on this network.

chain.copiedNote: Copied. Tell the payer to use the {net} ({std}) network only.

pb.title: Batch payouts
pb.sub: Pay many recipients at once: upload a sheet or use the API
pb.uploadTitle: Upload a sheet to pay many recipients at once
pb.uploadHint: One payout per row: chain (Ethereum / BSC / TRON), recipient, amount (USDT), and optional customer ID and your reference. CSV with a header row, up to 500 rows.
pb.apiNote: Integrated systems can use the API instead: POST /api/v1/payouts/batch/ (with Idempotency-Key; the same key counts once; add an IP whitelist in API settings first). Batches from both are listed below, and every item sends callbacks.
pb.tooMany: A sheet can have at most 500 rows; this one has {n}. Split it and upload again.
pb.badSheet: Could not read the sheet: the first row must be the header chain,to,amount (optionally customer_id,merchant_ref).
pb.summary: {n} rows: {ok} OK · {bad} with problems · {warn} to confirm.
pb.summaryNote: Rows with problems are not submitted.
pb.lineNote: Row numbers match the sheet (row 1 is the header). Addresses are checked per chain: Ethereum / BSC 0x + 40 hex (mixed case must match the checksum), TRON starts with T, 34 characters.

err.unknown_chain: Chain must be Ethereum / BSC / TRON
err.invalid_customer_id: Customer ID may only use letters, digits and _ . @ -
err.duplicate_row: Same as another row (chain, address and amount): pay twice?

pb.reupload: Fix the sheet and upload again
pb.onlyValid: Submit only the {n} rows without problems
pb.needOnlyValid: Rows with problems are not submitted: tick "submit only the rows without problems", or fix the sheet and upload again.
pb.sumTitle: By chain (no separate network fee; it is included in the payout fee)
pb.available: Available balance {v} USDT (shared by all chains)
pb.need: {v} USDT will be frozen (amounts + payout fees)
pb.notEnough: Insufficient balance: this batch needs {need} USDT but only {have} USDT is available. Remove some rows or wait for incoming payments.
pb.submitted: Submitted {n} items, batch {no}. Each item is reviewed and then paid; you get a callback for every item.
pb.late: Outside processing hours (8:00–23:00 UTC+8): it will be processed after 8:00 tomorrow.
pb.cancelConfirm: Only items not yet reviewed are cancelled; reviewed items are still paid. Cancelled amounts return to your available balance.
pb.cancelled: Cancelled {n} items; the amounts are back in your available balance.
